description: The individual bounces, complaints and failures behind the rates — newest first, keyset-paginated. Pass the returned cursor to page. Filter with kind=bounce|complaint|failed, or all (default).

cursor.description: Opaque keyset cursor from the previous page.

source_id.description: Restrict to a single sending source (36-char id). Omit for the whole pool.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.

name: send_list_undeliverable
